|ingredients = {{Name|Void Egg|1}} |quality = false |sellprice = 275 |edibility = -30 |crafttime = 3h |craftingstation = {{Name|Mayonnaise Machine}} }} '''Void Mayonnaise''' is an [[Artisan Goods|Artisan Good]] made by placing a [[Void Egg]] inside the [[Mayonnaise Machine]]. It can also be obtained by [[fishing]] in the [[Witch's Swamp]] if the player does not have one in inventory and the [[Henchman]] is guarding the [[Witch's Hut]] (5% chance). Gifting a Void Mayonnaise to the Henchman outside the [[Witch's Hut]] will allow players to pass during the quest [[Quests#Goblin Problem|Goblin Problem]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |love=Krobus |hate=Sebastian,Jas,Vincent,Sam,Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Linus,Pierre,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jodi,Kent,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Caroline,Leo }} ==Bundles== Void Mayonnaise is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Recipes== {{Recipes|header|hide=buff,duration}} {{:Strange Bun|RecipeRow/NoBuffs}} {{Recipes|footer}} ==Tailoring== Void Mayonnaise can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Polka Dot Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt272.png|24px]] It can also be used as a red dye in the dye pots, located at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== *Void Mayonnaise is required to complete the [[Quests#Goblin Problem|"Goblin Problem" Quest]]. One must be gifted to the [[Henchman]] guarding the [[Witch's Hut]]. ==History== {{History|1.1|Introduced.}} {{History|1.4|Removed from [[Traveling Cart]] stock.
